description:
Duration: 8 months 
 Location: Albany, NY , Foxborough, MA or Lisle, IL 
 Primary Objective: 
 • Develop & support Delivery pipeline of windows images (CM via Chef, image mgmt via packer/boxcutter or alternative) from AWS to remote devices running Linux (CM via chef) via ZFS snapshot replication. 

 • Experience managing & scripting Linux hardware servers. 

 • Experience with unreliable network environments. 

 • Develop automated testing for process to improve availability & reduce variance. 

 • Contribute to Synthetic Monitoring effort using NewRelic Synthetic Pro to detect failures on hybrid cloud solution. 


 Requirements: 
 
 • Engineering skills to accelerate critical software encapsulation WIN to UX for hosted and cloud infra with new product releases. 
 • Linux Administration (Ubuntu) to include advanced firewall configuration, ZFS, performance analysis, repeatable on-metal deployment, monitoring. 
 • Certificate management, Chef Development, Packer/Boxcutter experience to automate image deployment & versioning. 
 • Brilliant Manufacturing skills to include CD/CI experience automated infra testing and NewRelic Synthetics Pro
 • MUST have a BS in Computer science or equivalent
